{# ============================================================ APPOINTMENT LETTER - WORKER ============================================================ #} {% set applicant = frappe.get_doc("Job Applicant", doc.job_applicant) %} {# ---------------- JOB OFFER ---------------- #} {% set offer_name = frappe.db.get_value( "Job Offer", {"job_applicant": doc.job_applicant}, "name" ) %} {% if offer_name %} {% set offer = frappe.get_doc("Job Offer", offer_name) %} {% endif %} {# ---------------- DYNAMIC VALUES ---------------- #} {% set appointment_date = frappe.utils.formatdate( doc.appointment_date, "dd-MMM-yy" ) %} {% set branch = doc.custom_branch or "" %} {% set location = offer.custom_location_list if offer_name and offer.custom_location_list else "" %} {% set designation = offer.designation if offer_name and offer.designation else "" %} {% set salary_amount = ( doc.custom_monthly_gross_salary | float ) if doc.custom_monthly_gross_salary else 0 %} {% set salary_words = frappe.utils.money_in_words( salary_amount, "INR" ) %} {{ letter_head }}

Date: {{ appointment_date }}


To,
Mr. {{ applicant.applicant_name }}
{{ branch }}
{{ location }}


Subject.: Letter of Appointment for the Position of "{{ designation }}" at the Company’s Client location


Dear {{ applicant.applicant_name }}


Pursuant to your application seeking an employment with our establishment M/s. Vaaman Engineers (I) Limited (hereinafter referred to as the Company), and relying upon the submissions and representations provided by you during the course of your interview/discussion, the Company is pleased to appoint you in the services of the Company as {{ designation }} at its Client location M/s. {{ branch }} with effect from {{ appointment_date }} in accordance with the terms and conditions stated herein below in this Appointment Letter.


1) Effective Date: The effective date of your appointment is {{ appointment_date }}


2) Remuneration: During the term of your employment with the Company, you shall receive remuneration and/or benefits as set out in Annexure-A hereunder. The Company may, in its sole discretion, revise, review, adjust or withdraw certain components mentioned in the Annexure-A, at any time, subject to the requirements under the applicable laws.

Any remuneration or benefits provided to you hereunder shall be paid net of all deductions, including the statutory contributions and applicable taxes that are legally required or authorized to be withheld/deducted as per the applicable laws.

The Company shall be entitled to set-off any amounts that shall be payable by you to the Company, from the payment due to you against the remuneration, benefits, and/or other payments to be made by the Company to you, at its sole discretion.


3) Location and Hours of Work: You shall be required to render services at the above-mentioned client location or as may be communicated/notified from time to time. Your employment may be on job rotation basis, in such section, department, or location, and may be transferred or assigned to any other Client’s location or other offices of the Company or its client’s premises, at the discretion of the Management of the Company, depending upon the requirement and exigencies of work.

The refusal of such transfer on your part amounts to resignation and you shall be deemed to have resigned from the service of the Company without Notice from the date of refusal of such transfer.

You shall report at your work location within such time and on such date as may be communicated to you. You are required to strictly adhere to the daily shift timings as may be communicated to you by the Company and/or Client from time to time. You will be governed by all the applicable rules & regulations of the Company which are applicable during your employment, and you will follow all the working related instructions & guidelines applicable to the Site/location where you are deployed.


4) Duties and Responsibilities: During the term of your employment with the Company, you shall devote your entire time, effort, and attention exclusively towards discharging and performing the duties and responsibilities, as may be assigned to you by the Company, with efficiency, diligence and care. You will perform your duties efficiently and will not show any disobedience, insubordination to seniors.

You shall not, directly, or indirectly, engage in any business or service, whether as principal, agent, partner, consultant, employee or contractor or in any other capacity, either full time or part-time, whatsoever, other than that of your employment with the Company.


5) Leaves: You shall be entitled to avail leaves as per the statutory provisions and Company’s leave policy which are set out in the Company Policies or as may be communicated to you from time to time. You will not avail any leave without the prior permission of your Seniors, and if you proceed on leave without any permission or sanction, necessary/appropriate action may be initiated against you.


6) General Provisions

Company Policies: Your employment with the Company shall be governed by the rules, regulations, guidelines, policies and practices of the Company, which may be amended from time to time (“Company Policies”), and you shall abide by the same at all times. You are required to read and understand the Company Policies that shall be available for perusal at the Company’s Head office, Regional offices and in Company Website. In order to ensure discipline and good conduct, it is expected that you shall, at regular intervals (not less than twice in a calendar year), read the Company Policies, and you are permitted to seek clarifications from your Reporting manager in the case of any questions or queries in relation to the Company Policies. In case of any conflict between the terms of this Appointment Letter and Company Policies, the terms and conditions of the Company Policies shall prevail. Additionally, you may be required to adhere to certain policies of the Company’s client, where you are deployed, to ensure services to the client such as code of conduct, shift timings, Holidays, leave, weekly-holiday etc.


Conflict: You shall not, directly or indirectly, accept or retain for your own benefit any commission, rebate, discount, or profit from any person having business transactions with the Company.


Company Property: Any property provided to you by the Company, any data, documents (including copies) maintained or stored on the Company’s computer systems or other electronic equipment shall remain the property of Company. You will always maintain in good condition and safeguard Company’s property, or its clients, that may be given to you or used by you, during the course of your employment.


Non-Disparagement: You shall not take any action or make any statement that could: (i) discredit the reputation of the Company, or its business, products or services, or its shareholders or directors or officers; or (ii) result in any person ceasing to do business with the Company, or not engage in business with the Company.


Expenses: The Company may, at its discretion, deduct all expenses incurred in respect of your training, travel, accommodation, daily allowance, sundry and all other related expenses from any amounts payable to you, in case of termination of your employment within one (01) year from the date of joining.


No Direct Employment: You shall not be permitted to seek direct employment with the customers/ clients of the Company.


Medical Examination: The Company, in its sole discretion or at the request of its client, may require you to be examined by a registered medical practitioner or doctor to determine whether you are medically fit to work and can be deployed at the premises of the Company’s client. The costs for conducting such medical examination may be borne by the Client, Company or adjusted in your monthly salary as the case may be, at actuals, in the manner determined by the Company.


Verification of antecedents: Your employment with the company is subject to satisfactory verification of your antecedents (as provided by you to the Company in its Employment Form) and the educational testimonials. In case any discrepancy is found in any of the above, the management may initiate appropriate action against you for such false declaration, including termination of your services.


Transfer of service: Your employment with the Company will be transferable and the Company reserves the right to transfer your services to any other location, Group Company or where any of its associates have their establishments or it may set up new establishment/s.



7) Term: You are hired under a project-based contract between the Company and its client for fixed period of three (03) years, and as such your employment with the Company shall be co-terminus with the termination or completion of the said contract/arrangement of the Company with its client/customer and project.


8) Termination of Employment:

8.1 Upon completion of the arrangement of the Company indicated in clause No.8 above, your employment with the Company shall be terminable by the Company, at its sole discretion, in accordance with applicable laws.

8.2 Resignation: You may terminate your employment with the Company at any time, by assigning a proper reason and submitting a resignation letter to the Company. Upon receipt of acceptance of your resignation from the Company, you shall be required to serve notice for a period of one (01) month or such other notice period which may be applicable to you, as may be communicated by the Company.

8.3 Termination: The Company may, at its discretion, terminate your employment without assigning any cause, by issuing a written notice of termination. Upon receipt of the letter of termination from the Company, you would be required to serve the minimum notice period of one (01) month or receive notice pay in lieu of the said notice period, as may be determined by the Company.

8.4 Termination for cause: The Company may, at its discretion, terminate your employment with immediate effect, without any prior notice, unless required by applicable laws, in case of occurrence of the following events (“Termination Events”):

8.4.1 failure to perform or non-fulfilment of or breach of any of the covenants, obligations, terms, conditions or stipulations contained in this Appointment Letter or Company Policies;

8.4.2 breach of the rules of the Company’s client establishment you are deputed to;

8.4.3 commission of any acts, deeds, matters or things which are prejudicial to the rights or interest of the Company or causes loss to the Company or in any manner affects the reputation of the Company;

8.4.4 commission of any misconduct or dereliction of duty or gross negligence on your part;

8.4.5 completion, non-renewal and/or termination of contract with customer and/or client of the Company;

8.4.6 commission of fraud, dishonesty, embezzlement, theft etc. by you;

8.4.7 your involvement in an offence pertaining to moral turpitude, dishonesty or which otherwise impinges on your integrity;

8.4.8 you being sent to judicial custody, police custody or otherwise imprisoned or impeded in criminal proceedings or conviction for any offence under applicable laws;

8.4.9 your unapproved/unauthorized absence for more than a period of five (05) calendar days;

8.4.10 you receiving or giving bribes or unauthorised gratification in any form;

8.4.11 you refusing to accept charge-sheet, order or other communication served to you in accordance with the model standing orders under the Industrial Employment (S.O) Act, 1946 & the rules thereunder;

8.4.12 you being on strike at work or inciting others to strike at work in contravention of the provision of any law, or rule having the force of law;

8.4.13 you abating or instigating or acting in a manner in order to slow down work of your colleagues; in case of damage or loss of goods or property belonging to the Company or its clients;

8.4.14 breach of confidentiality obligation or misuse of any Confidential Information (as defined hereinafter) imparted to you during your tenure in the Company or any unauthorized use of Company’s proprietary rights;

8.4.15 your engagement in any other occupation, trade or business in the premises where you are deputed at or your engagement, whether directly or indirectly, in any business, in any capacity, either full time or part-time, whatsoever, other than that of the Company;

8.4.16 commission of offence of sexual harassment by you, as determined by the internal complaints committee constituted under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013; or


8.4.17 if any information furnished by you to the Company proves to be false or misleading, or if you are found to have wilfully suppressed any material information/particulars.

Upon occurrence of any of the aforementioned events, the Company would issue a termination notice to you and terminate your employment with immediate effect, in accordance with applicable laws.

The Company further reserves the right to take suitable action against you including initiating legal proceedings against you, in the event of occurrence of any of the Termination Events, as set out in paragraph 0 herein.

8.5 Abandonment of Job: In case: (i) of your unauthorized or unapproved absence from work for more than a period of five (05) working days, or (ii) you not reporting for your job for more than a period of five (05) working days, the Company may, at its discretion, take actions as per the Company Policies, including issuance of a termination notice to terminate your employment with the Company with immediate effect. In the event you abandon your job, you would not be entitled to receive any full & final settlement amount and the pending dues payable to you by the Company, if any, which would be adjusted as payment in lieu of minimum notice period required to be served by you.


8.6 Retirement: You shall retire from the Company’s services upon attaining the superannuation age of Fifty Eight, unless otherwise communicated separately in writing.

Consequences of Termination

Upon resignation, termination of your employment with the Company, you shall:

(i) immediately cease to use and return all the property issued to you by the Company or belonging to the Company, back to the Human Resources Department of the Company, including identity card, visiting card, sim card, laptop, if any;

(ii) settle all amounts due to the Company from you prior to your resignation, termination including loans, advances, petty cash etc., and deliver a release and no dues letter to the Company in the format provided by the Company to you;

(iii) cooperate with the Company in relation to any and all claims, controversies, disputes, or complaints pertaining to the business, of which you have any knowledge; and

(iv) obtain clearance from your Reporting Manager and other concerned departments of the Company, in order to assist the Company to settle your dues, if any.

Failure to return any property of the Company, would result in deductions from the full and final dues settlement payable to you by the Company.


9) Employee Data: You are required to provide to the Company complete and accurate information about yourself, including your name, address, emergency contact telephone numbers and details and documents as may be required from time to time, including change of any of the above. If such information is found to be untrue or false, appropriate action will be taken against you, including termination of your employment.


The Company may collect and store your personal data for various human resource management purposes and may pass such personal data to other third parties/agencies at its sole discretion, as per the Company’s legal requirement in accordance with applicable laws.


10) Indemnity: You shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company, its shareholders and affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, employees and representatives from and against any and all losses, direct, indirect or consequential, suffered or incurred by such persons, arising out of, or in connection with, or resulting from or relating to: (i) any failure to perform or non-fulfilment of or breach of any of the obligations contained in this Appointment Letter or Company Policies; (ii) negligence and/or misconduct on your part; and/or (iii) commission of fraud, dishonesty, embezzlement, theft etc. The Company shall have the right to set-off money payable to you against any dues under this paragraph.


11) Notices: Any notice, consent, request, waiver or other communication to you may be given in person (in writing or orally) or by post or courier service or by email as per the details available with us in the Company records, and shall be deemed to be effectively given: (i) if hand delivered in person or by messenger; (ii) if oral communication, at the time of communication; (iii) if sent by post or courier service, on receipt of acknowledgement; and (iv) if given by email, at the time of transmission.



12) Confidentiality: During the course of your employment with the Company, you may have access to and receive Company’s Confidential Information and otherwise, which shall, at all times, remain the property of the Company. You acknowledge that such Confidential Information shall only be used by you for the purposes of carrying out your duties, roles, and responsibilities in the Company and shall be kept secret and confidential and shall not be disclosed to any third party (including to any government and statutory authority) at any time, either before, during the term or subsequent to termination of your employment with the Company, without the prior written approval of the Company.

Notwithstanding anything contained herein, you are bound, strictly not to discuss and/or disclose in writing and/or by any third party, any information knowingly allusive to any Confidential Information and commission of such an act would constitute a material breach of this Appointment Letter.

For the purposes of this Appointment Letter, “Confidential Information” shall include, but is not limited to, all documentary and other information relating to the Company’s business and/or the Company’s clients’ business, either in hard or soft copy, including in particular list of clients and suppliers, details of finances, procurement requirements, purchasing, manufacturing, customer lists, business forecasts, sales, audit, intellectual property related information, staff, managers, directors, and marketing plans and information of any nature whatsoever, shared by any kind of communication devices. It also includes all information in respect of which the Company is bound by an obligation of confidentiality to any third party.


13) The Company will provide to its employees necessary Personal Protection Equipments (PPEs) including uniform, safety shoes, safety helmet etc. If you are found not wearing the PPEs as per the security guidelines, while on duty, disciplinary action will be taken against you as per the Company Policy which may include imposing fine, written warning, suspension from the services etc. You will ensure that the uniform is always neat and tidy. The Company will recover the cost of PPEs in case you resign from the services immediately from joining at the following rates i.e. within 3 months of joining full amount of PPEs will be recovered, within 6 months of joining 50% amount and the amount will be recovered from your Full & Final Settlement amount. In case, if there is no amount to be payable to under the full & final settlement, you will separately pay the amount towards the above-said recovery.


14) Governing Law and Jurisdiction: This Appointment Letter and the interpretation thereof, and any disagreements or disputes arising under this Appointment Letter, shall be subject to and governed by the laws of India. You agree that all disputes in relation to your employment with the Company shall be subject to the courts of Mumbai, India.


15) Further Assurance: You shall undertake to do such further acts, deeds and execute documents as may be requested by the Company, to effect and implement the understanding set out in this Appointment Letter and the Company Policies.


Wishing you a long and successful career with us.

Yours faithfully,

For & On behalf of M/s. Vaaman Engineers (I) Limited



Name: Alpana.Narkhedkar.
Designation: Associate General Manager.



I, the undersigned …………………., have read this Appointment Letter, the terms set-out herein and the Company Policies carefully and I understand and unequivocally accept the duties, responsibilities, rights, obligations, terms, and conditions of appointment stated above and in the Company Policies and agree to abide by the same.


As per the applicable laws and statutory requirements under the Employees' Provident Fund and MP Act, the Employees' State Insurance Act, and other relevant regulations, M/s. Vaaman Engineers (I) Ltd. requires certain details, including Aadhaar number, for the purpose of UAN and other statutory compliance requirements.


In accordance with Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial & Other Subsidies, Benefits & Services) Act 2016, and relevant data protection laws, I provide my voluntary consent to collect, store, and use my Aadhaar details strictly for the following purposes:


Declaration & Consent: I voluntarily provide my Aadhaar details to M/s. Vaaman Engineers (I) Limited for the purposes stated above.


The information mentioned in Annexure-A is true and correct, and the copies of the documents provided to the Company and mentioned in Annexure-B are true.


Date:

Place:



____________________________________________

Signature of employee

Name of the employee:


ANNEXURE-A

Details of Salary and Benefits:

1) You will be paid a consolidated Salary of Rs. {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(salary_amount, currency="INR") }}/- per month (Rupees {{ salary_words }} Only), subject to statutory deductions as applicable from time to time and subject to your prorated attendance records.

Terms and Conditions of Compensation & Benefits: -


(i) PF contribution will be deducted from Salary as per the provisions of the EPF & MP Act, and the ESI contribution will be deducted as per the provisions of ESI Act.

(ii) Bonus will be paid annually as per the provisions of the Payment of Bonus Act.

(iii) Gratuity will be applicable as per The Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972.

(iv) Monthly Salary details shown herein-above is for a calendar month having 26 working days and in case the number of working days vary in any calendar month, the monthly salary earnings will change accordingly.

(v) Statutory deductions such as PF, ESI, Profession Tax, LWF, Income Tax etc. will be deducted from the above stated salary as applicable.

Subject: Letter of Appointment
Dear {{ emp.get("employee_name") if emp.get("employee_name") else doc.get("applicant_name") }},
We are pleased to welcome you into the Vaaman Engineers family and look forward to a mutually beneficial association with us.
The terms & conditions of your Appointment are as follows:
  1. Your employment details are:
    1. Designation: {{ emp.get("designation") | upper if emp.get("designation") else "" }}
    2. Grade: {{ emp.get("grade") if emp.get("grade") else "" }}
    3. Date of Joining: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(emp.get("date_of_joining"), "dd") if emp.get("date_of_joining") else "" }}{{ doj_suffix }} {{ frappe.utils.format_date(emp.get("date_of_joining"), "MMMM-yyyy") if emp.get("date_of_joining") else "" }}
    4. Reporting: {{ manager_name }} - {{ branch }}.
    5. Location: {{ branch }}
  2. The Compensation & benefits applicable to you are described in the Annexure I attached to this Letter of Appointment subject to statutory deduction of the Income Tax, PF or any applicable provision and taxes as per standard practice of our organization.
  3. Your employment in the company is subject to you being found medically fit and satisfactory verification of antecedents, your past employment details, (as provided by you in the company employment form) and educational testimonials. However, in case any discrepancy is found in any of above, the management may initiate appropriate action for such false declaration, including termination of services.
  4. You shall be governed by the service Rules & Regulations and policies of the Company that are in force or will be introduced and /or modified from time to time. Any amendment or modification thereto shall be binding on you.
  5. You shall diligently carry out such duties as assigned to you and during such hours as may be stipulated by the Company and perform your duties as may be assigned to you from time to time, in shifts, if required.
  6. Your employment with the Company shall be transferable and the Company reserves the right to depute / transfer your services to any other location or Group Company or where any of its associates have their establishments or may set up new establishments. Upon such transfer, applicable transfer expenses will be reimbursed to you against presentation of supporting documents.
  7. The refusal of such transfer on your part amounts to resignation and you shall be deemed to have resigned from the service of the Company without Notice from the date of refusal of such transfer.
  8. You will be on training for a period of 12 (Twelve) months. The said training period can be terminated earlier or extended further at the sole discretion of the management. During or at the end of training period or extended training period, if management is not satisfied with your service, your service shall be terminated without assigning any reason, without giving any notice.
  9. After successful completion of training period you may be considered for probation in writing based on your overall performance during the training period. Unless confirmed in writing, you will continue to be on training period. Probation period will be of 6 (Six) months from the date of completion of training period.
  10. Your services are liable to be terminated without assigning any reason thereof without giving you notice/notice pay during training period.
  11. Notwithstanding anything contained hereinabove, the Company is at liberty to terminate your service forthwith without assigning any reason thereof or any notice or any compensation, in case you are found guilty, of any act of disobedience, insubordination, incivility, insobriety, dishonesty, or of any act or omission, conduct or commission or irregularity, whether during the course of employment or otherwise which in the opinion of the company is detrimental to its interests.
  12. While in the services of the Company, you shall not engage directly or indirectly in any trade or business or undertake any other employment with or without any commercial gain. Breach of this condition shall lead to immediate termination of your services by the Company without any notice or compensation.
  13. At the time of termination of employment, you shall return all materials of the Company and shall not use it further for other company or for your personal purpose.
  14. You will deliver all such data and information to the Company upon the Company’s request and, in any event, upon termination of employment, and will be fully responsible for the care and protection thereof until such delivery.
  15. All information, data and knowledge regardless of form, generated in the performance of or delivered during employment, as well as any information provided to you by the Company, shall be and remain the sole property of the Company. You shall not divulge the same in any manner whatsoever or use it for your benefit or for the benefit of any other person. You shall not use company resources for other commercial activities or for personal gain.
  16. You shall strive to plan and complete work in shortest possible time and as scheduled. You will guide your team to excel on all work allotted. You will give your whole time and attention to the said engagement and shall use your best endeavor to improve and expand the same and shall in all respects diligently and faithfully obey and observe all lawful orders and instructions of your Superiors in relation to the conduct of the said business and shall not, at any time (whether during continuance of your employment or thereafter) divulge any secrets or dealings thereto.
  17. You are requested to carry out all the duties, which may be reasonably required from you from time to time by the Management.
  18. You will be governed by all the rules and regulation applicable as per the Grade Level Structure of the Company during your employment.
  19. You agree that during the term of employment and for a period of twelve months after the termination of your employment, you shall not in any way, directly or indirectly:
    1. Induce or attempt to induce any employee of the Company to quit employment with the company.
    2. Otherwise interfere with or disrupt Company’s relationship with its employees.
    3. Solicit, entice, or hire away any employee of the Company
    4. For a period of one year from the date of you ceasing to be an employee of the Company, neither you nor any of your associates will solicit the employment of any of the employee(s) engaged in the business of the company and/or its associate/group companies.
  20. The Company prides itself as a Company with highest order of ethical conduct in dealing with customers, dealers, vendors, suppliers, subcontractors, staff or the like by whatever name called. As part of your association with the Company it is important that you fully understand this philosophy and the policies governing it. You shall maintain utmost discipline and good conduct in your dealing with your colleagues, customers etc. The Company values every employee as an individual and an asset of the Company and will not tolerate any objectionable behavior including however not limiting to verbal abuse, sexual harassment, gender discrimination, misuse of Company property, theft, cheating or any such act of any individual or body of individuals.
  21. You shall, at all times while at the Company’s premises/ Associate’s premises:
    1. Act diligently, ethically, soberly and honestly;
    2. Not consume or be under the influence of alcohol or use any drug, unless prescribed by a medical practitioner or lawfully available without prescription and used in accordance with directions.
    3. Comply with all occupational health or safety policies of the Company.
    4. Comply with all procedures, rules, regulations, standards of conduct and lawful directions of the Company in respect of use of its premises, equipment, business ethics or methodology or contact with the staff or customers.
    5. Not commit any criminal offence and not otherwise breach any law or regulation which could adversely affect the interests of the Company or the provisions of the Services.
    6. Not sexually harass any person.
    7. Not engage in discriminatory behavior
    8. Carry and display at all times appropriate company identification and
    9. Not otherwise act in any manner, which could disrupt or adversely affect the Company’s business reputation, interests or goodwill.
    10. Not do any act that is prejudicial to Company’s interest or commit breach of ethical policy/ policies of the Company as detailed in Ethics Policy.
  22. You shall communicate to the company any change in your address as well as personal status. All communication sent to you in the normal course to the address given by you shall be deemed to have been received by you.
  23. In the unlikely event of any information furnished by you in connection with your employment with us, is suppressed or found to be false or incorrect, your services are liable to be terminated forthwith, without any Notice Pay or compensation whatsoever.
  24. The age of retirement on superannuation is 58 years.
  25. The Courts of law at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising under this agreement. All claims, actions, proceedings and disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be commenced accordingly.
  26. In acceptance of the aforesaid terms of appointment, please sign and return the duplicate copy of this letter.
  27. The Company reserves the right to alter the above Terms & Conditions at its discretion.
We look forward to your joining the Vaaman family soon and wish you a rewarding and successful career with the Group.
For Vaaman Engineers (India) Ltd.



Alpana N.
Associate General Manager.
“I Accept the Appointment on the terms mentioned above.”



Signature of Acceptance.
Strictly Confidential

Subject: Letter of Appointment


Dear {{ applicant.applicant_name }},

We are pleased to welcome you into the {{ doc.company }} family and look forward to a mutually beneficial association with us.

The terms & conditions of your Appointment are as follows:


1. Your employment details are:
a) Designation: {{ applicant.designation }}.
b) Date of Joining: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(offer.custom_joining_date) if offer_name else "" }}
c) Reporting: {{ reporting_emp.employee_name if emp and emp.reports_to else "" }}.
d) Location: {{ applicant.custom_location }} site.


2. During your employment with us you shall be paid consolidated Monthly Gross Salary Rs. {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(salary_amount, currency="INR") }}/- (Rupees {{ salary_words }} Only) subject to statutory deductions as per law.


3. Leave eligibility & administration will be as per Company leave policy applicable to your work site.


4.Your employment in the company is subject to you being found medically fit and satisfactory verification of antecedents, your past employment details, (as provided by you in the company employment form) and educational testimonials. However, in case any discrepancy is found in any of above, the management may initiate appropriate action for such false declaration, including termination of services.


5. You shall be governed by the service Rules & Regulations and policies of the Company that are in force or will be introduced and /or modified from time to time. Any amendment or modification thereto shall be binding on you


6. You shall diligently carry out such duties as assigned to you and during such hours as may be stipulated by the Company and perform your duties as may be assigned to you from time to time, in shifts, if required.


7. Your employment with the Company shall be transferable and the Company reserves the right to depute / transfer your services to any other location or Group Company or where any of its associates have their establishments or may set up new establishments. Upon such transfer, applicable transfer expenses will be reimbursed to you against presentation of supporting documents.


8. The refusal of such transfer on your part amounts to resignation and you shall be deemed to have resigned from the service of the Company without Notice from the date of refusal of such transfer.


9. You will be on Probation for a period of 6 (Six) months from the date of Joining. The said probation period can be terminated earlier or extended further at the sole discretion of the management. Unless communicated in writing, you will continue to be on probation period. During or at the end of probation period or extended probation period, if management is not satisfied with your service, your service shall be terminated without assigning any reason, without giving any notice/notice pay.

Registered Office: 510, Sai Leela Commercial Complex, S.V.Road, Borivali West, Mumbai - 400092, Maharashtra, India

10. After confirmation, the Notice period or notice pay on resignation or termination shall be subject to One month on either side or one month’s gross salary in lieu of notice. However, the management reserves the right to accept your resignation with effect from such date as it may deem fit, considering the criticality of the assignment and the prevailing business exigencies.


11. Notwithstanding anything contained hereinabove, the Company is at liberty to terminate your service forthwith without assigning any reason thereof or any notice or any compensation, in case you are found guilty, of any act of disobedience, insubordin ation, incivility, insobriety, dishonesty, or of any act or omission, conduct or commission or irregularity, whether during the course of employment or otherwise which in the opinion of the company is detrimental to its interests.


12. While in the services of the Company, you shall not engage directly or indirectly in any trade or business or undertake any other employment with or without any commercial gain. Breach of this condition shall lead to immediate termination of your services by the Company without any notice or compensation.


13. At the time of termination of employment, you shall return all materials of the Company and shall not use it further for other company or for your personal purpose.


14. You will deliver all such data and information to the Company upon the Company’s request and, in any event, upon termination of employment, and will be fully responsible for the care and protection thereof until such delivery.


15. All information, data and knowledge regardless of form, generated in the performance of or delivered during employment, as well as any information provided to you by the Company, shall be and remain the sole property of the Company. You shall not divulge the same in any manner whatsoever or use it for your benefit or for the benefit of any other person. You shall not use company resources for other commercial activities or for personal gain.


16. You shall strive to plan and complete work in shortest possible time and as scheduled. You will guide your team to excel on all work allotted. You will give your whole time and attention to the said engagement and shall use your best endeavor to improve and expand the same and shall in all respects diligently and faithfully obey and observe all lawful orders and instructions of your Superiors in relation to the conduct of the said business and shall not, at any time (whether during continuance of your employment or thereafter) divulge any secrets or dealings thereto.


17. You are requested to carry out all the duties, which may be reasonably required from you from time to time by the Management.


18. You will be governed by all the rules and regulation applicable as per the Grade Level Structure of the Company during your employment.


19. You agree that during the term of employment and for a period of twelve months after the termination of your employment, you shall not in any way, directly or indirectly:
a) Induce or attempt to induce any employee of the Company to quit employment with the company.
b) Otherwise interfere with or disrupt Company’s relationship with its employees.
c) Solicit, entice, or hire away any employee of the Company.
d) For a period of one year from the date of you ceasing to be an employee of the Company, neither you nor any of your associates will solicit the employment of any of the employee(s) engaged in the business of the company and/or its associate/group companies.


20. The Company prides itself as a Company with highest order of ethical conduct in dealin g with customers, dealers, vendors, suppliers, subcontractors, staff or the like by whatever name called. As part of your association with the Company it is important that you fully understand this philosophy and the policies governing it. You shall maintain utmost discipline and good conduct in your dealing with your colleagues, customers etc. The Company values every employee as an individual and an asset of the Company and will not tolerate any objectionable behavior including however not limiting to verbal abuse, sexual harassment, gender discrimination, misuse of Company property, theft, cheating or any such act of any individual or body of individuals.


21. You shall, at all times while at the Company’s premises/ Associate’s premises:
a) Act diligently, ethically, soberly and honestly;
b) Not consume or be under the influence of alcohol or use any drug, unless prescribed by a medical practitioner or lawfully available without prescription and used in accordance with directions.
c) Comply with all occupational health or safety policies of the Company.
d) Comply with all procedures, rules, regulations, standards of conduct and lawful directions of the Company in respect of use of its premises, equipment, business ethics or methodology or contact with the staff or customers.
e) Not commit any criminal offence and not otherwise breach any law or regulation which could adversely affect the interests of the Company or the provisions of the Services.
f) Not sexually harass any person.
g) Not engage in discriminatory behavior
h) Carry and display at all times appropriate company identification and
i) Not otherwise act in any manner, which could disrupt or adversely affect the Company’s business reputation, interests or goodwill.
j) Not do any act that is prejudicial to Company’s interest or commit breach of ethical policy/ policies of the Company as detailed in Ethics Policy.


22. Company will provide as per applicability all PPEs including 2 sets of uniform per year, one set of safety shoes, safety helmet. If you are found not wearing, while on duty, disciplinary action will be taken in the form of levy of fine. You will ensure that the uniform is always neat and tidy. In case anybody resigns, deduction for PPE will be as follows (If applicable). Within 3 months of issue full amount, within 6 months of issue 50% amount and after 6 months of issue NIL amount to be recovered from Full & Final Settlement


23. You shall communicate to the company any change in your address as well as personal status. All communication sent to you in the normal course to the address given by you shall be deemed to have been received by you.


24. In the unlikely event of any information furnished by you in connection with your employment with us, is suppressed or found to be false or incorrect, your services are liable to be terminated forthwith, without any Notice Pay or compensation whatsoever.


25. The age of retirement on superannuation is 58 years.


26. The Courts of law at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising under this agreement. All claims, actions, proceedings and disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be commenced accordingly.


27. In acceptance of the aforesaid terms of appointment, please sign and return the duplicate copy of this letter.


28.The Company reserves the right to alter the above Terms & Conditions at its discretion.



We look forward to your joining the Vaaman family soon and wish you a rewarding and successful career with the Group.



For Vaaman Engineers (India) Ltd.


Associate General Manager-HR


“I Accept the Appointment on the terms mentioned above.”



Signature of Acceptance.
